_comment: Does a Wait in place keep capture progress? (DERIVATION 42, for
engine/sim.py.) Fixture: savestate slot 1 -- P1's Infantry (slot 2)
one tile south of a neutral city at (4,1), the A15 fixture. Script
capture field is bits 11-15 of the unit record's +4 halfword.
The turn-change poll read the active byte as 0 throughout, so
end_turn() reported false, but the day counter advanced past each
pair of End Turns and the unit's acted bit cleared -- the turns ran.

drives.note: move north, Capt: +10 for a 10-bar Infantry
a Wait in place keeps the progress
continues from 10: 10 + 10 = 20, the city falls, the field reads 0
